name: ai-employee-platform
description: AI Employee Platform — Digital Workforce Operating System (500 Canonical Role Packs)

scripts.clean: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); ['packages', 'apps'].forEach(dir => { if (fs.existsSync(dir)) fs.readdirSync(dir).forEach(p => { ['dist', '.next', 'tsconfig.tsbuildinfo'].forEach(sub => { const target = path.join(dir, p, sub); if (fs.existsSync(target)) fs.rmSync(target, { recursive: true, force: true }); }); }); }); if (fs.existsSync('tsconfig.tsbuildinfo')) fs.rmSync('tsconfig.tsbuildinfo', { force: true });"
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:web
scripts.test: npm run test:catalog && npm run test:runtime && npm run test:security && npm run test:billing && npm run test:tools && npm run eval:catalog
scripts.verify: npm run clean && npm run typecheck && npm run build:packages && npm run build:web && npm test && npm run validate:manifests && npm run verify:hashes && npm run verify:security && npm run verify:payments && npm run verify:auth
